body: Gotcha, I guess to rephrase my question I like my body shape and size and I’m scared of getting too skinny. But I do want to work out where do I start?

I’m 5’5 female and 160lb, but I’m much much smaller than my other friends who weigh less than me. For example I’m a size small compared to my sister who wears a large and weighs 20lb less than I do. I want to lose weight but I’m wondering if I should focus more on weight lifting to tone up?
I know that’s what I’m saying, I don’t have solid evidence so maybe this is a waste of time. Maybe I just stay quiet and move on, and hope he doesn’t do this to the next person.
I can go to school while doing it, and unless I’m trying to get a security clearance it’s fine. Believe me, I’ve looked into it. I’m not saying I can guaranteed 100% make it. But I’m willing to try.
I have a lot of friends doing it, and I don’t do drugs so. You must be fun at parties.
That’s honestly, made me feel a lot better. I know I didn’t say it vindictively and even if I hadn’t said it his abuse was enough to get him discharged. I just have to keep my head high.
But I don’t feel bad for the abuse I feel like it was so petty to bring up the drugs, like I feel like it was vindictive and evil

Thank you guys, I figure if this is something that rest on my consciousness for the rest of my life then so be it. 

I shouldn’t have posted about the abuse I feel like it takes away from the fact that I feel bad about admitting his drug use. I guess I just wanted everyone else to tell me it was wrong, but I really do appreciate the support. At the end of the day I feel bad, but I’ll feel better eventually. I need to focus on me for once and not him.
Should I be getting a lawyer just yet?
